data.name: Naadim
data.gender_notes: Naadim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Naadim means a companion or a friend. In Islamic context, it refers to someone who accompanies or associates with others. The name Naadim carries the meaning “Companion, Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Naadim usually hope their child will grow to embody companion, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, companionship and brotherhood are emphasized as essential aspects of Islamic community (e.g., Surah Al-Ma'idah, Verse 2).
data.etymology: Naadim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Companion, Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Naadim total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: ناعم
in_arabic.meaning: المقبول للجميع، الودود، المتفاهم، المتسلم، الناعم
in_arabic.long_meaning: الناعم: الاسم من ناعم، يريد أن يكون المقبول للجميع، لا يؤذي أحدًا، وودود، ومتفاهم، ومتسلم. والقران الكريم يذكر في سورة المرسلات(40:34): (وَكَأَنَّما أُذِنَ لَهُمْ وَيَضُرُّ مَنْ أَصابَهُ الْعَذَابُ وَيُذَهِبُ عَنْهُمْ عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ).

in_urdu.name: ناعم
in_urdu.meaning: منظور ہے کہ ناعم، ہمدرد، بے داغ، بے تکلف، متفق
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام ناعم سے مراد ہے کہ وہ ناعم، ہمدرد، بے داغ، بے تکلف اور متفق ہو۔ اس کا تعلق ناعم (ناعِم) سے ہے جس کے معنی ہیں کہ وہ نیکوکار ہو، کسی کو نقصان نہ پہنچائے اور ہر کے ساتھ معاون ہو۔

in_hindi.name: नाअम
in_hindi.meaning: वो जो अन्य को नुकसान न पहुंचाने वाला है, सहृदय, सहमति, सहनशील
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाअम नाम से तात्पर्य है कि वह अन्य को नुकसान न पहुंचाने वाला है, सहृदय, सहमति, सहनशील, और अनुकूल हो।

in_pashto.name: نااعم
in_pashto.meaning: وړاندې شوي، ځانګړي، د خپل ژوند څه شوي، د نورو پرت شوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: نااعم: نااعم يو نوم دی چې په پښتو ژبه کې د ګټي او ښه چارو لپاره کارول کېږي. دې نوم د نااعم په معنا سره وړاندې شوی دی چې په دې معنا د خپل ژوند څه شوی، د نورو پرت شوی دي.

in_english.name: Naadim
in_english.meaning: Welcoming, friendly, gentle, understanding, tolerant, and acceptable to all
in_english.long_meaning: Naadim is an Arabic name that means welcoming, friendly, gentle, understanding, tolerant, and acceptable to all. In the Quran, it is mentioned in Surah Al-Mursalat (40:34) that those who are welcomed and their suffering is removed. In Islamic tradition, Naadim is associated with the qualities of being gentle, kind, and understanding.

The name also highlights the significance of building a community based on mutual respect, understanding, and love.

It reminds us that we are not alone in this world and that we have a constant companion in Him. Ultimately, the name Naadim encourages us to strive for strong and meaningful relationships with both our fellow human beings and our Creator.
